nineTriples.theirs: canonical nine-triple organization of 27 states, Pass10477-10484, from the Wilson 13:6 normalizer
nineTriples.ours: the 9 minimum blockers at each centre partition the far-27 into 9 disjoint 3-cocliques, at all 40 centres
nineTriples.why: a nine-triple organization of 27 is a common architecture -- at least 200,000 exist on this graph alone -- so matching the shape is close to no evidence of a shared object
nineTriples.whatSurvives: the 360 minimum blockers select exactly 40 of those partitions, one per centre, with no choices made
